items.name: Performance Collection
items.description: Collects performance data and sends it to Amazon.

items.name: Performance Counters
items.description: Background performance logging on Fire OS 8 devices.

items.name: Telemetry Emitter
items.description: Sends device telemetry to Amazon (Fire OS 8).

items.name: Minerva Metrics
items.description: Amazon's "Minerva" metrics service, which batches usage data and uploads it.

items.name: Minerva Log Collector
items.description: Collects system logs for the Minerva metrics service.

items.name: Fire TV Framework Metrics
items.description: Usage metrics from the Fire TV interface.

items.name: Privacy Pass Service
items.description: Issues Privacy Pass tokens used for ad measurement.

items.name: Content Recognition (ACR)
items.description: Automatic content recognition: identifies what's playing on screen for Amazon's ad and recommendation data.

items.name: Hybrid Advertising ID
items.description: Advertising ID service used for targeted ads.

items.name: Special Offers Background Service
items.description: Background ad service behind Special Offers on Fire OS 8. Saves memory and CPU when off.

items.name: Sneak Peek Previews
items.description: Auto-playing promotional previews on the Home screen.

items.name: Upgrade Prompts
items.description: "Upgrade your Fire TV" prompts.

items.name: Early Access Prompts
items.description: Early-access and preview programme prompts.

items.name: Retail Demo Content
items.description: Demo-mode content used on shop display units.

items.name: Home Recommendations Feed
items.description: Feeds recommended content rows on the Home screen. On some builds Home rows go empty while it is off - switch it back on if yours do.

items.name: Release Notes
items.description: Shows "what's new" pop-ups after Fire OS updates.

items.name: Notification Center
items.description: Amazon's notification panel and promotional notifications. You won't see system notifications while it's off.

items.name: Remote Tutorial
items.description: The on-screen remote control tutorial.

items.name: Support Screens
items.description: Built-in help and support screens.

items.name: System Notices
items.description: System notice pop-ups. Some Fire OS versions switch it back on at restart.

items.name: Smart Home Map
items.description: Alexa smart home map view.

items.name: Matter Smart Home
items.description: Matter smart home support. Switch off only if you don't control smart home devices from the TV.

items.name: Matter Co-host
items.description: Lets the Fire TV act as a Matter hub for other devices.

items.name: Amazon Photos
items.description: Amazon Photos app and photo screensaver source. Safe if you don't view Amazon Photos on the TV.

items.name: Games Hub
items.description: Games hub and Amazon Luna entry point.

items.name: Kindle Connector
items.description: Kindle content connector.

items.name: Website Shortcuts
items.description: Opens web-app shortcuts from the Home screen.

overrides.description: Voice settings menu and input manager. On Fire OS 8 (e.g. Fire TV Stick 4K Max 2nd Gen) some users report a stuck boot logo after disabling it together with other core services - take a snapshot first.
Persistent link to Amazon's servers (sign-in, sync). On Fire OS 8 some users report a stuck boot logo after disabling it - not recommended.
Shared metrics library other Amazon apps report through. Some users report other apps misbehaving while it is off - take a snapshot first.
Used by the Alexa voice features on newer Fire OS versions as well as the ads screensaver. Voice search can stop working while it is off.
